summary: Crash when clicking "Presets" after setting the superflat preset with a non-existent biome
description: Crash when you click "Presets" after replacing the "minecraft:plains" to a non-existent biome in the superflat customization menu I was creating a world called "Nether" with Superflat, I replaced "minecraft:plains" to "minecraft:the_nether" to see if the piglins won t turn to zombified piglins, I clicked "Done" and clicked "Presets" again to see if "minecraft:the_nether" doesn t has turn onto "minecraft:plains" again, and The Game Crashed What I expected to happen was: When I click presets after replacing it, it should resets to default. What happened was: It crashed after I press presets. How to reproduce: Create a new world in Superflat click on Customize, after click on Presets replace the biome from "minecraft:plains" to a non-existent biome in the superflat customization menu after click on Done and Presets again and see if it crash(If you press cancel it won t crash)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Superflat world.
2. Click on "Customize" after selecting Superflat.
3. In the customization menu, click on "Presets".
4. Replace the biome from "minecraft:plains" to a non-existent biome (e.g., "minecraft:the_nether").
5. Click "Done" and then click "Presets" again.
6. Observe that the game crashes after clicking "Presets".
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.16.2, 1.16.3 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.3, 1.16.4 Pre-release 1, 1.16.4 Pre-release 2, 1.16.4 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.4
Observed Behavior: When attempting to reproduce this bug, I created a new Superflat world named "Nether." In the customization menu, I replaced the default biome setting of "minecraft:plains" with "minecraft:the_nether," intending to test if piglins would remain non-zombified. After clicking "Done," I navigated back to the "Presets" option to see if the biome had reverted to "minecraft:plains." However, upon clicking "Presets," the game crashed immediately. The expected behavior was for the presets to reset to default settings when selecting them after changing a biome. Instead, the game crashed as soon as I pressed "Presets." To reproduce this issue, start by creating a new Superflat world and click on Customize. Then, go to Presets, replace the biome from "minecraft:plains" with any non-existent biome in the customization menu, and click Done. Subsequently, clicking on Presets again should trigger the crash. If you cancel instead of pressing presets, the game will not crash.
Expected Behavior: When I click "Presets" after replacing the biome with a non-existent one, the game should reset to default settings without crashing. The interface should handle invalid biome inputs gracefully and revert to the standard configuration, allowing me to continue customizing my world without interruption.
